styles.name: Storyflow
styles.sample: Ke mana pertanyaanmu pergi saat memakai AI?
styles.risk: Clearly label simplified models; never present conceptual graphics as literal system diagrams.

styles.name: Curiosity Lab
styles.motion: split-screen test, liquid-like reveal, annotated evidence
styles.sample: Kenapa dua gelas ini mencair dengan kecepatan berbeda?
styles.risk: Do not stage demonstrations as authentic experiments or omit critical controls.

styles.name: Data Shock
styles.motion: numeric morph, scale zoom, cause-linked comparison
styles.sample: Seberapa lama satu juta detik dibanding satu miliar?
styles.risk: Every number needs verified units and source attribution.

styles.name: Myth Breaker
styles.risk: Avoid exaggerated security claims; address limits and uncertainty.

styles.name: Micro Drama
styles.motion: parallax stage, spotlight turn, timeline branching
styles.sample: Satu keputusan yang mengubah arah sejarah komputer
styles.risk: Distinguish dramatization from fact; verify historical claims.

styles.name: Product X-Ray
styles.motion: component separation, exploded diagram, side-by-side result
styles.sample: Apa yang sebenarnya diselesaikan alat ini?
styles.risk: Use real product capabilities; disclose sponsorship or affiliate arrangements.
